name: Rebellion Against God
overview: Scripture reveals rebellion against God as a deliberate turning away from His commands and worship, exemplified by Pharaoh's refusal to acknowledge the LORD and let His people go, questioning who God is to be obeyed. This rebellion is marked by hardened hearts and idolatry, as seen in Israel's swift departure from God's way to worship a molten calf. God warns His people to heed His guidance and not provoke Him, for He will not pardon transgressions lightly. Yet, despite their stiffnecked nature, God’s fatherly care and readiness to forgive upon repentance remain central to His dealings with His people.
